## 7. Phone script — calling the hospital or doctor's billing office

**Before you call:** Have the denial letter, your member ID, and the claim/reference number 00000000 ready.

**Call:** Example Imaging Center's billing department — the number is on your bill or denial letter.

**Say:**

"Hello, my name is [your name]. I'm calling about a denied claim for an MRI lumbar spine on September 14, 2026, reference number 00000000. The insurance denied it saying conservative treatment wasn't documented, but I had eight weeks of physical therapy before the MRI. I'm filing an appeal and I need some information.

First, can you send me an itemized statement showing the CPT code — I think it's 72148 — and all the charges?

Second, can you place a hold on my account so it doesn't go to collections while the appeal is in process?

Third, does Example Imaging Center participate in my insurance plan, [plan name]? The denial shows $1,650 as my responsibility with code CO-50, and I need to know whether that's a contractual write-off or actually my responsibility.

Fourth, my orthopedist ordered this MRI because of new leg weakness — that's a red-flag finding. Will your office send the orthopedist's order and any records you have to the insurance company to support the appeal, or do I need to get those myself?

Also, do you have a financial-assistance program or a prompt-pay discount if I end up owing part of this?

[If they say they'll help with the appeal:] What records will you send, and when? Can I get the name and direct number of the person handling this so I can follow up?"

**Call log:**
- Date and time: ______
- Spoke with: ______ Title: ______
- Direct line: ______
- What they're doing: ______
- What I need to do: ______
- Follow up by: ______

---

## 8. Records and itemized-bill request letter

[Your name]  
[Date of birth]  
[Address]  
[Phone]  
[Date]

Example Imaging Center  
Medical Records and Billing Departments  
[Address from your bill or denial letter]

RE: Patient [name], Date of Birth [DOB], Date of Service September 14, 2026

To Whom It May Concern:

I am requesting copies of my complete medical records and an itemized billing statement for the MRI lumbar spine performed on September 14, 2026, under my right of access to my health information.

**Medical records requested:**
- The order for the MRI from my orthopedist
- Any intake or registration forms
- The MRI report and images (or image summary)
- Any other documentation related to this visit

**Billing records requested:**
- Itemized statement listing every charge with its CPT or HCPCS code
- Explanation of code CO-50 on the denial and whether Example Imaging Center participates in my insurance plan

These records are needed for an insurance appeal with a deadline of March 31, 2027. Please send them to the address above within 30 days, or contact me at the phone number above if you need clarification.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this request.

Sincerely,

____________________  
[Your name]
data.clock: for employer and marketplace plans, the plan must decide an appeal for care already received within 60 days of receiving it (30 days per level if it has two appeal levels); care already received is never expedited
